description.value:
You conjure frigid water and douse an ally, fortifying their resolve. The target can immediately attempt a Will save with a +2 circumstance bonus against an ongoing emotion effect or against the frightened or stupefied condition, suppressing the effect or condition for the duration on a success. In addition, the target gains a +1 status bonus to all saving throws for the duration, which increases to a +2 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.
